about: An OpenID Connect identity provider and OAuth 2.0 server that connects to many login sources.

prs.title: Device login works again when dex runs under a path
prs.broken: Since version 2.46.0, signing in on a device like a TV failed with an unregistered redirect error for public clients when dex was served under a path such as /dex.
prs.changed: The check now accepts the device callback under the server's path as well.
prs.matters: Command-line and TV apps that use device login can sign in again.
